summary: Lift phrases out of the Captain's own rendered text and choreograph them through a physics-simulated (not keyframed) sequence of composable primitives, ending in a synthesized result landing permanently near an anchor.
whenToUse: Synthesizing 2-4 related concepts already visible in recent conversation into one crystallized insight.
Expressive emphasis moments, not routine responses -- this is a deliberate rhetorical/visual act, not default UI behavior.
When the result text is already decided -- this capability does not generate or infer the synthesis itself.
whenNotToUse: Do not use for content the Captain hasn't already decided on -- result text is always a required input, never computed here.
Do not use more than once in quick succession -- it is a deliberate emphasis device; overuse dilutes it.

invocation.legacyMethod: SemanticMetamorphosis#perform(spec) -- sugar for orbit->shed->morph->crystallize->land, unchanged signature

primitives.lift: implicit first step; args: { phrases: string[] }
primitives.orbit: args: { turns?: number=1, radius?: number=54 } -- bodies spring-chase a continuously-advancing point on a circle, per-body phase/speed/radius jitter
primitives.scatter: args: { radius?: number=90 } -- each body springs to an independent random point
primitives.converge: args: {} -- all bodies spring toward the shared anchor point
primitives.shed: args: { fraction?: number=0.35 } -- that fraction of characters fly off as independent impulse-driven fragments and fade
primitives.morph: args: { to: string } -- the actor's text is swapped mid-transition, body continuity preserved
primitives.merge: args: { into: string } -- all actors converge and combine into one new actor carrying the group's mean velocity
primitives.pulse: args: { strength?: number=0.25, count?: number=1 } -- scale/brightness impulse, springs back
primitives.crystallize: args: { glyph?: string='◆' } -- appends the glyph with a stronger pulse
primitives.trail: args: { on?: boolean=true } -- toggles fading motion-trail ghosts on subsequent steps
primitives.land: args: {} -- (auto-merges if >1 actor remains) settles onto landTarget and becomes a permanent plain DOM node

opts.sourceContainer: Element -- contains the rendered text the source phrases will be located within
opts.phrases: string[] -- 1-6 phrases to locate (case-insensitive, first match each) and lift out
opts.resultText: string -- fallback synthesized text for steps that don't specify their own
opts.landTarget: Element -- where the final result is permanently inserted
